chunks: Likewise, Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā said: So I said to Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, “O Abū Jaʿfar, I wished that this report had come from a source other than Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh.” He said: “He had narrated to me ten years before the perplexity.”

key_terms.أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: the named transmitter whose route is being mentioned
key_terms.الْحَيْرَةِ: the period of perplexity or confusion
key_terms.الْخَبَرَ: the report or hadith being discussed
key_terms.غَيْرِ جِهَةِ: from a source or route other than

ai.seo_question: What does this report say about the timing of transmission from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh before the ḥayrah?
ai.summary: This passage preserves a follow-up remark about the transmission of a hadith and the reliability of its route. Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan responds that he had received the report from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh ten years before the period of confusion, indicating the earlier provenance of the narration.
